{{Quote|You never should've crossed me, kid!|Mokko's final words to Benni Baro|<ref name="The Crossing">{{TBB|The Crossing}}</ref>}}
'''Mokko''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Mokko's species|alien]] [[Mokko's crew|gang]] [[Crime lord|boss]] who operated in [[Mokkotown]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Ipsidon]]<ref name="Retrieval" /> during the start of the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Date" />

Mokko would give food to his "top earner," and gave a small ration of [[Foodstuff|food]] to the rest of his workers, including [[Benni Baro]]. However, having a gluttonous appetite, Mokko kept most of the food for himself without his workers knowing.<ref name="Retrieval" />

After his manipulation of his workers was outed by Benni Baro, Mokko was confronted by his workers and [[Clone Force 99]]. The standoff ended in Mokko's death as he fell from a walkway over molten ipsium, during which he attempted to pull Benni down with him when he offered his hand. Ultimately, the workers came together and saved Benni, leaving Mokko to die alone.<ref name="Retrieval" />
